translations.web: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
translations.bsb: Whoever does not love Me does not keep My words. The word that you hear is not My own, but it is from the Father who sent Me.
translations.kjv: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.
translations.asv: He that loveth me not keepeth not my words: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's who sent me.
